name: RealityKit Voxel Mesh Generation
definition: Generates a single `MeshResource` from an array of voxel positions and colors to render ~1M voxels in real time, avoiding the per-entity overhead of instantiating individual `ModelEntity` objects.
summary: RealityKit Voxel Mesh Generation packs voxel geometry into a single MeshResource for real-time rendering, avoiding the per-entity overhead of individual ModelEntity objects.
